summary: Phase 2 validation of TUGMA (dataset + control engine). Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard KPIs, controls list+detail+run, transactions pagination/search/filter/sort, transactions hero TX-847291, exceptions list+filter+hero EXC-CTRL-005-TX-847291 explainability, reports+stellar NOT_SUBMITTED, organization, regulatory sources, logout, protected route). Verified: 10,000 deterministic transactions, exactly 122 exceptions total (CTRL-005=82 FAIL, CTRL-002=30 FAIL, CTRL-004=10 WARNING, CTRL-003=NOT_TESTABLE, CTRL-001 vendor), pagination returns pages=400 for page_size=25, control run appends new control_test_run (1->2) without duplicating exceptions (exception_code stable, total stays 122). Hero exception explainability panel returns expected='PHP 10,000.00' actual='PHP 9,500.00' variance='PHP 500.00' result='FAILED'. Stellar network=TESTNET verification_status=NOT_SUBMITTED (as expected). Frontend: Playwright walk verified dashboard KPIs (10,000 / 5 / 122 / 72 / 28% / 88), find-hero-txn on Transactions page navigates to TX-847291, TX detail shows money flow 10,000 -> 9,500 with CTRL-005 FAIL and linked exception, why-flagged-panel shows PHP 10,000.00 / PHP 9,500.00 / PHP 500.00 / FAILED, exc-workflow present, search+filter on transactions, exceptions page renders 25 rows and detail opens, controls page lists CTRL-001..005 and CTRL-005 detail shows BSP mapping + 82 failures, reports shows 10,000 tx / 122 exc / NOT_SUBMITTED, settings shows admin, logout redirects to /login, protected route redirects unauthenticated to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: api.py control detail caps exceptions.to_list(200) — fine for demo (max 82) but should paginate the related-exceptions section for scale.
auth cookie secure=True samesite='none' correct for HTTPS preview; would block plain-http local dev.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with credentialed cookies works via ingress rewrite here; must be tightened for production.
engine.run_all_controls appends to control_test_runs on every call — good for history, but consider a rate/throttle to prevent unbounded growth from repeated POST /api/controls/run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_tugma_backend.py (pytest, 26 tests) is the regression baseline. Backend sort param uses raw field names (transaction_amount / transaction_timestamp); the UI Select maps 'Newest/Oldest/Amount ↑↓' to those values correctly. page_size is enforced 1..100 by Pydantic (422 above 100). find-hero-txn lives on the Transactions page (not Dashboard). Logout testid is 'logout-button'. Stellar NOT_SUBMITTED and empty evidence artifacts are intentional — not bugs.
